thread:
alex.r: heads-up: deploy-bot flagged a canary anomaly in eu-west-1 for payments-service. connectionPool value bumped by chart v2.14.0 and we're seeing a 3x connection spike.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary health degraded: 9/20 pods > 250 open DB conns; 5 pods entering CrashLoopBackoff; metric spike at 00:12 UTC. Suggested action: quarantine canary, hold promotion.
alex.r: quarantine applied. Can we decide pin vs rollback? Change window closes in ~30m. @priya @marco
priya: quick read: values.yaml shows pool.size: 100 -> 300, pool.timeout: 30s -> 5s. That explains the spike. If we pin to previous chart (v2.13.7) we keep new images but old values. Rollback would revert images + values.
marco: if we rollback images we'll lose a small fix for retry logic that backend wants. Product prefers pin->hotfix unless it's unsafe.
release-ops: note: legal change window is 45m for eu-west today; we have 30m left before scheduled freeze. Manual pin requires a release note update and a signed-off rollback plan.
sre-oncall: risk assessment: connection burst is causing DB connection pool saturation and some OOMs. Pinning values back to 100 should relieve pressure immediately. But need to ensure no config drift in other regions.
alex.r: proposal: manual values revert (helm values set) on canary namespace, promote to staging verification for 10m, then either allow chart promotion or rollback images if retry bug causes user-visible regressions.
priya: agree. Steps:
```
# patch canary helm release with previous values
helm upgrade payments-canary ./charts/payments --namespace payments-canary --reuse-values --set connectionPool.size=100,connectionPool.timeout=30
kubectl rollout status deploy/payments-canary -n payments-canary
```
Then monitor DB conn metric + pod restarts for 10 minutes.
marco: if pods keep crashing after revert, we do full rollback to v2.13.7 image tag and scale to 0->3 sequentially.
alex.r: who's on exec for release notes & signoff? @release-ops can you assemble a short blurb noting the hotfix and pin decision? We need one-sentence summary for the audit log.
release-ops: on it. Draft:
"Canary: reverted connectionPool values in eu-west canary after spike caused by an unintended values bump in chart v2.14.0; pin applied pending downstream hotfix. No user-facing downtime observed." Will post PR link in 5m.
sre-oncall: monitoring hooks added: grafana alert muted for 15m while we validate; alerts will re-enable automatically. Also added temporary traffic split to 0% for canary if error rate > 2%.
alex.r: ok executing manual values revert now. Will post status updates.
alex.r: done. helm upgrade returned 0. Pods are rolling, one pod OOMed during restart but now 4/5 healthy.
priya: DB conns dropped to baseline within 3m. No further OOMs.
marco: product acked keeping retry fix; will open a PR for config validation to prevent large pool bumps.
release-ops: release note PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-4321 — tagging security and compliance for record.
sre-oncall: unmuting alerts. We'll watch for 20m then decision to promote or fully rollback. Good job team :thumbsup:
alex.r: leaving this thread open for final decision. If any regression within 20m we rollback images. Otherwise promote chart but keep pinned values in canary until hotfix merges.
